index.lede: Talaria Flow builds order flow tools for NinjaTrader and teaches the concepts behind them. Open your NinjaTrader account through our partner link and the full 30-video course is yours, free, with written materials and lesson notes sent to your inbox.

index.f2s: NinjaTrader account via our link · no deposit required
index.s1h: Three steps. No card, no catch.

0.0: Register and create an account with NinjaTrader
0.1: Create your NinjaTrader account using our partner link. No deposit is required. It costs you nothing extra and it is what funds the free course.

1.0: Create an account with Talaria Flow
1.1: Sign up here, then upload two screenshots: the NinjaTrader Welcome dashboard and the Web trading platform in Simulation. Blur anything private.

2.1: We review by hand. Once approved you receive a confirmation email and course access before 31 December 2026.

index.s2h: Thirty videos on reading order flow data to execute on real price moves.
index.s2p: From the first footprint cell to a full session plan built on structure. Every module comes with written materials and lesson notes, delivered to your inbox. No indicators to buy, no signals to follow — the mechanics, taught properly.
index.s3p: Every Talaria Flow tool is written for NinjaTrader and every lesson in the course is taught on it. If you are looking for a futures trading platform, this is the one we are building on.
index.devH: The Talaria Flow tools suite is on its way.
index.devP: Profiles, reference levels and alerts, sharing one engine. Leave your email and you will hear when it ships.

course.vidP: A short walkthrough: every click from opening your NinjaTrader account to uploading your proof, with the buttons marked as we go.
course.h2: Seven modules, starting with how markets actually move.

0.1: Why markets move: balance, imbalance, value and the two-way auction that every profile and footprint is built on.

1.1: POC, value area, single prints, poor highs and lows, developing structure.

2.1: Reading bid × ask cells, stacked imbalances, unfinished business.

3.1: Divergence, exhaustion, where delta lies and where it doesn't.

4.1: Fair value through the session, deviation bands, anchoring to events.

5.1: Spotting the fights that decide direction and the ones that don't matter.

6.1: Turning structure into a plan you can execute before the open.

howSteps.0: Register a NinjaTrader account using our partner button only, in a normal (not private) browser window. You must be new to NinjaTrader. Screenshot 1: the Welcome dashboard.
howSteps.1: On the dashboard click Start trading, then Access Simulation. The trading platform opens. Screenshot 2: the platform. This must happen within 7 days of registering.
howSteps.2: Create a Talaria Flow account with the same email.
howSteps.3: Upload your proof screenshots from your dashboard.
howSteps.4: We review manually. Once approved, you receive a confirmation email and course access before 31 December 2026.

s1.p: Futures and forex trading contains substantial risk and is not for every investor. An investor could potentially lose all or more than the initial investment. Risk capital is money that can be lost without jeopardizing ones’ financial security or lifestyle. Only risk capital should be used for trading and only those with sufficient risk capital should consider trading. Past performance is not necessarily indicative of future results.

s2.p: Hypothetical performance results have many inherent limitations, some of which are described below. No representation is being made that any account will or is likely to achieve profits or losses similar to those shown; in fact, there are frequently sharp differences between hypothetical performance results and the actual results subsequently achieved by any particular trading program. One of the limitations of hypothetical performance results is that they are generally prepared with the benefit of hindsight. In addition, hypothetical trading does not involve financial risk, and no hypothetical trading record can completely account for the impact of financial risk of actual trading. for example, the ability to withstand losses or to adhere to a particular trading program in spite of trading losses are material points which can also adversely affect actual trading results. There are numerous other factors related to the markets in general or to the implementation of any specific trading program which cannot be fully accounted for in the preparation of hypothetical performance results and all which can adversely affect trading results.

s3.p: This presentation is for educational purposes only and the opinions expressed are those of the presenter only. All trades presented should be considered hypothetical and should not be expected to be replicated in a live trading account.

s4.p: Testimonials appearing on this website may not be representative of other clients or customers and is not a guarantee of future performance or success.

s2.i1t: email address and a hashed password.
s2.i2t: screenshots you upload to show you opened a NinjaTrader account, plus any note you add. These may contain personal data such as your name or email; we ask you to blur anything not needed.

s3.i2t: To send confirmation, resubmission and course-access emails (performance of a contract).
s3.i3t: To send indicator news if you opted in (consent; withdraw any time).

s4.p: Verification screenshots are deleted within 90 days of a decision. Account data is kept while your account is open and deleted 12 months after closure. Waitlist emails are kept until you unsubscribe.

s5.p: We use hosting, database and email providers to run the site; they act on our instructions. We do not sell your data. NinjaTrader tracks sign-ups made through our partner link under its own privacy policy; we do not send them your screenshots.

s6.p: Some providers store data outside the UK/EEA. Where they do, we rely on standard contractual clauses or an adequacy decision.

s7.p: Under UK GDPR and EU GDPR you can ask for access, correction, deletion, restriction or portability of your data, and object to processing. Email support@talaria-flow.com. You can complain to the UK Information Commissioner's Office or your local EU authority.

s8.p: We store a login cookie, your language choice, and a cookie-settings choice so we can remember whether you accepted the notice. There are no analytics, no advertising cookies and no third-party trackers. A short notice appears until you choose Accept or Essential only; you can change that from Cookie settings in the footer.

s1.p: Talaria-Log Ltd ("we") offers free access to a 30-video order flow course to people who (a) open a NinjaTrader account through our partner link, (b) create an account on this site, and (c) upload proof that we accept. Review is manual and at our discretion. Approved members receive course access by email before 31 December 2026.

s2.p: You must be 18 or older and legally able to open a NinjaTrader account in your country. One course grant per person.

s3.p: You confirm screenshots are genuine and unedited beyond blurring private details. Falsified proof leads to removal from the programme.

s4.p: The course and everything on this site is educational. Nothing here is investment advice or a recommendation to trade. See our disclaimers.

s5.p: We are an independent partner in the NinjaTrader Ecosystem. We may receive a commission when you open an account through our link. We are not NinjaTrader and do not act for it.

s6.p: Course videos and site content belong to Talaria-Log Ltd. Personal use only; no redistribution.

s7.p: We may update these terms or end the offer with notice on this page. Approved members keep the access already promised.
